block.title: PMZ Fees Assignments & Pricing Configuration
block.div: Configure default Fees Assignments for membership online applications and examination forms. Any changes to items, rates, or multi-line fees structure assignments here will automatically drive the billing system with zero hardcoded values.

setting.help: Generate default items, fees structures, and assignments if not yet created.

setting.title: Standard Membership Fee
setting.help: Used for Associate, Student, Retiree, and Fellow member registrations ($25 default).

setting.title: Full & Professional Membership Fee
setting.help: Used for Full Member and Professional Member registrations ($100 default).

setting.title: CPM Exam Fee per Module
setting.help: Fees Assignment applied to CPM modules attempted ($25 default).

setting.title: DPM Exam Fee per Module
setting.help: Fees Assignment applied to DPM modules attempted ($30 default).

setting.title: CM&E Exam Fee per Module
setting.help: Fees Assignment applied to Certificate in Monitoring & Evaluation ($25 default).

setting.title: PGDPM Exam Fee per Module
setting.help: Fees Assignment applied to Post Graduate Diploma modules ($40 default).

setting.title: Default Payment Journal
setting.help: Default Bank or Cash journal used for processing online or offline member payments.
